text: A股三大指数集体冲高回落，农业、CRO概念逆势走强。宇树科技涨超5%，总市值重返2000亿元。 恒指、恒生科技指数半日跌超0.7%，恒生生物科技指数涨超2%，金斯瑞生物科技大涨逾16%。 习近平就发展先进制造业作出重要指示强调，持续做大做强先进制造业，为推进中国式现代化提供有力支撑。 香港金管局加息25个基点至4.25%。 中国央行公开市场逆回购操作7620亿元，单日净投放1590亿元。 广电总局：机顶盒功能将以软件形态内置于电视机；前8个月上线微短剧中AI剧超九成。
text_en: The three major A-share indices collectively surged then pulled back, with agriculture and CRO concepts strengthening against the trend. Unitree Robotics rose over 5%, with total market value returning to 200 billion yuan. The Hang Seng Index and Hang Seng Tech Index fell over 0.7% in the half-day session, while the Hang Seng Biotech Index rose over 2%, with GenScript Biotech surging over 16%. Xi Jinping issued important instructions on developing advanced manufacturing, emphasizing the need to continuously expand and strengthen advanced manufacturing to provide strong support for advancing Chinese-style modernization. The Hong Kong Monetary Authority raised interest rates by 25 basis points to 4.25%. The PBOC conducted 762 billion yuan in reverse repo operations in the open market, with a single-day net injection of 159 billion yuan. NRTA: Set-top box functions will be built into televisions in software form; over 90% of micro-dramas launched in the first eight months were AI-generated.
